Bug_Explanation: The class contains overloaded methods named finalize with parameters, which is misleading because they will not be called by the garbage collector. The finalize method in Java should not have parameters and is meant to clean up before object destruction.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which directly invokes the overloaded finalize methods with parameters. This triggers the FinalizeOverloaded bug as these methods are not part of the Java object finalization mechanism and will not be called by the garbage collector.
